# truenas_ntp_server (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS NTP server by address.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) Hostname or IP address of the NTP server to look up.

### Read-Only

- `burst` (Boolean)
- `iburst` (Boolean)
- `id` (Number) Numeric NTP server ID assigned by TrueNAS.
- `maxpoll` (Number)
- `minpoll` (Number)
- `prefer` (Boolean)
